verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a first-party API reference that covers programmatic management of projects, experiments, datasets, logs, prompts, tools and scorers. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at standard paths. Playgrounds are a prompt-iteration feature, not an API explorer, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: interactive API explorer, runnable in-browser request examples, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of the reference's usability.
